items.name: Water Flask
items.description: A dented field flask with a fresh seal and clean water.

items.name: Medkit
items.description: A compact pack of sealed dressings and colony first-aid supplies.

items.name: Scrap Coil
items.description: A worn induction coil. Someone at the market can still use the copper.

items.name: Damaged Servo
items.description: A salvaged worker-droid servo, still fit for a field repair.

items.name: Scrap Alloy
items.description: Cleaned structural alloy recovered from feral machines.

items.name: Nanite Residue
items.description: Recoverable tier-one nanites from a damaged industrial core.

items.name: Copper Filament
items.description: Fine conductor salvaged from a machine winding.

items.name: Micro Capacitor
items.description: An intact low-voltage capacitor from a drone's charge bus. Charge cell cores need two.

items.name: Stabilised Pistol Grip
items.description: A field-fabricated grip that steadies the scrap pistol.

items.name: Cracked Optic Lens
items.description: A scrap drone's targeting lens, cracked at the rim but still true at the centre.

items.name: Intact Actuator
items.description: A heavy worker-droid joint actuator with its feedback loop unbroken. Rare in the Berms.

items.name: Quantum Lattice Shard
items.description: A sliver of quantum-stable lattice from Tir's old fabrication cores. It hums against the palm.

items.name: Foreman Control Core
items.description: The depot foreman's command core. Its stored shift schedules include full Mark II pistol schematics.

items.name: Refined Alloy Plate
items.description: Scrap alloy pressed and nanite-bonded into a true, stress-relieved plate.

items.name: Wound Copper Coil
items.description: Salvaged conductor rewound on a field jig; the heart of any charge circuit.

items.name: Charge Cell Core
items.description: Two capacitors and a wound coil sealed in nanite resin: a stable nano-charge store.

items.name: Bored Alloy Barrel
items.description: A refined-alloy barrel bored true on the fabricator. Hits harder and carries further.

items.name: Salvaged Capacitor Cell
items.description: A larger nano cell built around a charge core. More shots before the pistol runs dry.

items.name: Gyro-Braced Grip
items.description: A grip braced by a live actuator loop. It fights recoil and nudges your aim onto moving machines.

items.name: Lattice-Focused Barrel
items.description: A lattice shard seats behind a salvaged optic, focusing each nano pulse. Heavy hits, slightly slower cycling.

items.name: Overclocked Charge Cell
items.description: Twin charge cores tuned through a lattice shard: deep reserves, cheap shots, fast refill.

items.name: Scrap Pistol
items.description: A nanite-fed sidearm rebuilt from Ward scrap. Its fit follows the field primer.

items.name: Field Rifle
items.description: A practical long arm with a repairable receiver and room for field modifications.

items.name: Field Vest
items.description: Salvaged plates and stitched canvas protect the torso without sealing out the heat.

items.name: Field Boots
items.description: Reinforced boots with replaceable soles and dust seals.

items.name: Neural Targeting Implant Mk I
items.description: A basic targeting lattice that improves sighting and pistol control.

items.name: Neural Targeting Implant Mk II
items.description: A higher-grade targeting lattice with finer tracking and signal stability.

items.name: Reinforced Myofibre Implant
items.description: A serviceable muscle-assist mesh for carrying and close work.

items.name: Field Backpack
items.description: A braced canvas pack with modular external cargo straps.

items.name: Precision Rifle Barrel
items.description: A field-machined barrel that trades some weight for steadier, longer shots.

items.name: Field Toolkit
items.description: Reusable gauges and hand tools for fitting and fabrication work.

items.name: Cognition Relay
items.description: A ceramic relay that stabilises the implant signal path during complex work.

items.name: Sighting Co-processor
items.description: A compact targeting co-processor for a cranial implant. Helps hold a steadier sight picture.

items.name: Reflex Buffer
items.description: A low-latency buffer for neural and limb interfaces. Sharpens controlled movement.

items.name: Reserve Nanocell
items.description: A sealed reserve cell that gives the implant additional nano capacity.

items.name: Recovery Regulator
items.description: A regulator that smooths recovery demand after exertion.

items.name: Load-bearing Coupler
items.description: A reinforced coupler for limb implants. Shares load across the assisted muscle fibres.

items.name: Ablative Chest Plate
items.description: A replaceable ceramic-faced plate. Fits an outer or inner chest plate pocket.

items.name: Impact Liner
items.description: A layered shock liner for modular armour. Reduces physical impact transfer.

items.name: Thermal Liner
items.description: A reflective woven liner that reduces heat transfer through armour.

items.name: Stride-assist Motor
items.description: A compact motor pair for powered leg rails. Increases movement speed while fitted.

items.name: Ankle Stabiliser
items.description: A spring-damped ankle unit that eases sustained movement in field boots.

items.name: Grip Damper
items.description: A vibration-damped glove insert for steadier control of a held weapon.

items.name: Field Helmet
items.description: A fitted composite shell with a replaceable liner and sealed utility mount.

items.name: Field Arm Guards
items.description: Segmented guards that leave the elbows clear for tool and weapon work.

items.name: Field Gloves
items.description: Reinforced gloves with a replaceable grip insert and thin inner liner.

items.name: Field Leg Armour
items.description: Articulated thigh and shin panels with a serviceable powered-assist rail.

items.name: Cardiac Regulator
items.description: A serviceable regulator that supports prolonged exertion. Accepts three augmentations.

items.name: Stride Interface
items.description: A limb-control interface that smooths the effort of moving in field gear. Accepts three augmentations.

items.name: Dermal Support Mesh
items.description: A subdermal support mesh for exposed work. Accepts three augmentations.
